cohort: All hospital deliveries in Suriname in 2017.
finding: The study revealed a PPH prevalence of 9.2% and a severe PPH prevalence of 2.5% in Suriname, with risk indicators including African descent, multiple pregnancy, delivery in Hospital D, cesarean section, stillbirth, preterm birth, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a risk indicator for severe PPH.
